subject: Re: Coordinating regional capacity split (US / EU / APAC) for Manticore SOW
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@variant.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@cloudzone.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — Manticore SOW: regional split conversation

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Manticore's procurement team asked me to get final confirmation on how Redwood would allocate dedicated capacity across regions for their planned pilot. They expect:~50M tokens/month during pilot (mostly chat gen), primarily in APAC (Singapore) and EU (Frankfurt) with a smaller US presence for fallbacks.

Key asks from procurement:
- A proposed committed capacity split by region (vGPU-equivalent nodes + burst lanes)
- Expected SLOs (p95 latencies) by region and fallback behavior
- Any partner prerequisites if we want to run nodes in Singapore through CloudZone (they've asked about local compliance).

I've attached the SOW draft Manticore shared (Manticore_SOW_v2.pdf). Procurement also flagged they could sign if we can guarantee an APAC activation within 8 weeks.

Can you loop in sizing/ops and CloudZone so we can provide a short proposal by next Friday?

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Customer Success, Variant.ai
Attachment: Manticore_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@variant.ai>, procurement@manticore.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, partners@cloudzone.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — Manticore SOW: regional split conversation

Hi Alice / Manticore team,

Thanks — looping in infra and partnerships to propose a concrete regional split. Quick summary of what we need to confirm internally:
- Workload mix: conversational + embedding reranks (Alice, procurement: confirm token mix % between chat vs embedding/rerank during pilot)
- Target p95 latency SLO per region and acceptable fallback tolerance (e.g., route to EU if APAC is saturated)
- Compliance notes for Singapore nodes (CloudZone team: what evidence & timeline for KMS/HSM + audit copies)

Karthik, David — can you draft a technical sizing + activation timeline for APAC and EU that assumes the pilot traffic profile in the attached SOW? Please include:
1) vGPU-node equivalents (in our internal units) per region for steady-state and 2x burst buffer,
2) estimated token cost / month, and
3) time to activate (cloud onboarding + partner prechecks) if we commit today.

I'll coordinate contracting timelines with procurement and CloudZone.

Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@variant.ai>, partners@cloudzone.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial ask — Manticore SOW: regional split conversation

+1 on questions — pasted a compact sizing sketch below based on the SOW token estimate (50M tokens/month) and the expected concurrency profile they described on the call.

Assumptions: 50M tokens/mo, 75/20/5 percent split by region (APAC/EU/US) traffic distribution for pilot, average request length 80 tokens, p95 target 250ms generation latency. Model: moderate LlamaX-40B variant quantized to 8-bit.

Proposed committed pool (steady-state) by region (vGPU-equivalent nodes):
- APAC (Singapore): 8 nodes steady + 8-node burst buffer (2x) — supports ~38M tokens/mo with headroom
- EU (Frankfurt): 3 nodes steady + 3-node burst buffer — supports ~9.5M tokens/mo
- US (us-east fallback): 1 node steady + 1-node burst buffer — supports ~2.5M tokens/mo

Estimated monthly token-processing cost (variable): ~ $XX,XXX (we'll provide finalized pricing with CE) — ballpark assumes quantized inference and autoscaling efficiencies.

Activation timeline:
- If CloudZone partner prechecks complete in parallel: APAC activation in 5-6 weeks (provisioning + partner KMS/HSM check + routing).
- EU activation 2-3 weeks (standard cloud region).
- US fallback active by day 7 (existing backbone).

Risk notes / mitigations:
- Partner dependency for APAC: CloudZone needs service account + audit snapshot; suggest a joint runbook and a pre-cert checklist.
- Burst lanes billed as reserved-but-unused if not consumed; propose a 3-month trial on burst billing before longer commit.

I'll attach a compact capacity spreadsheet — David, Priya: please review numbers and add actual vGPU SKU mapping and cost.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Planning, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cloudzone_capacity_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 34KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@variant.ai>, procurement@manticore.ai, partners@cloudzone.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — Manticore SOW: regional split conversation

Thanks all — summarizing next steps and asks so procurement can finalize SOW edits:
- Redwood to propose final committed split (we'll convert Karthik's vGPU-equivalents into SOW language): APAC 8 steady / 8 burst, EU 3 steady / 3 burst, US 1 steady / 1 burst.
- CloudZone: confirm KMS/HSM onboarding checklist and estimated lead time (we need this by Wed 21 Apr to keep 8-week APAC target).
- Manticore procurement: confirm the traffic mix (chat vs embedding %) so we can lock estimated token cost.
- Contract ask: 3-month burst trial pricing clause + canary rollout clause for first 2 weeks.

If CloudZone confirms the prechecks this week and procurement signs the SOW with the burst trial clause, we can hit a first APAC activation in ~5-6 weeks. I'll open a HubSpot deal note and attach Karthik's spreadsheet and the SOW draft.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a short one-pager for procurement and a partner playbook for CloudZone.

Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
